core_obligations: Prove that for f locally of finite type between locally Noetherian formal algebraic spaces and an etale surjective cover of Y by the Y_i, the morphism f is rig-surjective exactly when every base change f_i is
proof_roadmap: Forward: rig-surjectivity is stable under base change, so each f_i is rig-surjective.

Backward: the disjoint union of the f_i is rig-surjective, the disjoint union of the g_i is rig-surjective because it is an etale cover, and composition gives rig-surjectivity of the disjoint union map toward Y.
That morphism factors through X, so the permanence lemma makes X to Y rig-surjective.
